name: DataTable
intent: Feature-rich data grid on TanStack Table: sorting, filtering, pagination, row selection, column show/hide and reorder, expandable detail rows, and nested/tree rows.
when: More than ~10 rows, or any interactivity (sort / filter / paginate / select)
Tabular domain records the user needs to scan, sort, search, or act on in bulk
Rows that expand to a detail panel, or nested/tree data
Server-paged lists too large to fetch at once — see the manual pagination/sorting/search props
whenNot: Static or lightly-interactive rows with a custom layout -> use Table
A handful of fixed rows that never sort/filter/paginate -> use Table
A single record's labeled fields -> use PropertyList
Key metrics / KPI tiles -> use Card (or a MetricCard widget)

chooseOver.because: Table is presentational (static rows, custom layout, no built-in features). DataTable adds the TanStack engine: sorting, filtering, pagination, selection, column visibility/order, and row expansion.

columns.note: TanStack column defs. A `select` column (row checkbox) and an `actions` column (row menu) are NOT built in — provide them as columns when needed. A column given the id `actions` is STYLED for you: w-px, max-w-none, overflow-visible, text-clip, whitespace-nowrap. Body cells otherwise truncate at max-w-0 so long text ellipsizes, which is right for text and wrong for a column of buttons — the ellipsis there does not mean the label is too long, it means the column was squeezed and a control is half-drawn behind a "…". Naming the column `actions` is enough; meta.cellClassName is for other control columns, or to override part of what actions gets.

dataContract.rowIdentity: TanStack row.id (array index as a string) — no getRowId prop is exposed. bulkActions.onClick(selectedIds) yields these index-based ids; map to your domain ids yourself.

slots.renderSubComponent: ({ row }) => ReactNode — detail panel shown when an expandable row is open
slots.toolbarExtra: ReactNode — extra controls on the right of the toolbar
slots.filterStrip: ReactNode — a filter row rendered under the toolbar

searchKey.note: MUST equal a column's accessorKey/id, or the search box renders but filters nothing (fm-dt-1).

bulkActions.note: { label, icon?, onClick(selectedIds), variant? }. A floating action bar appears while rows are selected.

states.default: Toolbar (optional search + column toggle), bordered table, footer (selected count + pagination).
states.empty: Built-in single 'No results.' row spanning all columns when data or the active filter yields zero rows.
states.selected: Selected rows get data-state=selected; footer shows 'N of M row(s) selected'; a floating bulk-action bar appears if bulkActions are provided.
states.expanded: Rows with getRowCanExpand show an expander; renderSubComponent renders the detail panel; tree rows indent by depth.
states.loading: NOT built in — render your own Skeleton/Spinner in place of the table while fetching.

commonMistakes.mistake: searchKey set to a column id that doesn't match any accessorKey/id
commonMistakes.symptom: Search input renders but filtering does nothing
commonMistakes.fix: Set searchKey to an existing column accessorKey (e.g. "email").
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: A searchKey that doesn't match a column accessorKey (see fm-dt-1)

commonMistakes.mistake: Using DataTable for a few static rows
commonMistakes.symptom: Heavy engine + toolbar for no benefit

commonMistakes.fix: Add a `select` column to columns — selection UI is consumer-provided.

commonMistakes.mistake: Treating bulkActions selectedIds as domain ids
commonMistakes.symptom: Ids are array indices, not your record ids
commonMistakes.fix: Encode a stable id in your data and resolve it yourself (no getRowId prop today).

commonMistakes.symptom: Flash of the empty 'No results.' state while data is fetching
commonMistakes.fix: Render a Skeleton/Spinner until data resolves, then mount DataTable.

evaluationCriteria.check: DataTable chosen over Table when rows are interactive or number more than ~10.
searchKey (if set) matches a column accessorKey/id; no unknown config keys; pageSize > 0.
columns and data both provided; columns is a non-empty ColumnDef array.
No searchKey that fails to resolve to a column (fm-dt-1).
Renders a table with a header and rows, or the built-in empty state — non-empty markup.
